messages:
marco: rolled the `surge_window_rebalance` tweak to continuous-batcher in prod ~22:40 UTC. noticing p95/p99 jump on small requests, throughput down a bit. anyone watching?
infra-bot: Deployment: continuous-batcher config v1.14 -> v1.15 applied to cluster-rw-prod (cb-config: surge_window_rebalance=true)
marco: quick stats from dashboards: p95 120ms -> 340ms, p99 320ms -> 980ms, throughput -8%. KV cache miss rate climbed 2.1% -> 7.8% according to the runtime profiler snapshot.
alice: on it. can you paste the config snippet you rolled?
marco: sure — the only change in the rollout was this small block:
```
continuous_batcher: 
  surge_window_rebalance: true
  token_budget_targets:
    small_window: 40  # was 64
    medium_window: 96
  merge_on_idle: false
```
priya: ah — lowering small_window token_budget from 64->40 will cause earlier flushes and likely more tiny microbatches. that can trigger a kernel selection flip to less-optimized paths. grep kernel-selection logs for `fallback` entries.
marco: profiler snippet:
```
kernel_stats:
  chosen: fast_attn_v2 (60%)
  fallback: generic (35%)
  unavail: 5%
batch_shapes: spike at 1x16 and 1x32, fewer 4x64 coalesced batches
kv_cache_hit: 92.2% -> 89.0%
```
sam: seeing a lot of 1x16 microbatches in the trace. that matches the hypothesis — smaller token budget => emitter flushes early => coalescing suffers. by the time kernel selector runs, shape distribution favors smaller kernels with higher per-token overhead.
priya: we should revert small_window to ~56-64 for now and re-enable `merge_on_idle: true` with a short idle window (e.g., 5s) so we let coalescing complete before flush. also consider tagging small batches to prefer `fast_attn_v2` affinity during kernel selection.
alice: can we canary that? i’ll prepare a rollback patch and test on 2 nodes. also, the KV miss spike suggests placement/priming changed — check prefix TTL and prefetch behavior for small windows.
marco: started canary: cb-canary-2234 with token_budget.small_window=56 and merge_on_idle=true. pushing now.
ops_oncall: alerting noise: routes /generate_chat and /complete burned 15% of error budget; suppressing alerts for canary nodes and notifying SRE.
infra-bot: Canary metrics (cb-canary-2234): p95 -> 160ms, p99 -> 420ms, throughput ~99% of baseline. KV misstrend back down to 92.0% hit.
sam: looks like reverting token budget fixed batching/coalescing. PR incoming to add `kernel_affinity: preferred=fast_attn_v2` for 1x* shapes and a regression test that simulates high small-req traffic.
marco: reverting global rollout and applying staged canary config across zones. follow-up: add unit/integration perf test for 'token_budget' changes that asserts no >2x p99 delta and kv_hit degradation. thanks all :thumbsup:
